description: Live board statistics from cache (cheap to call): servable and tracked posting totals, the count of company job boards with open roles (boards, not employers — one employer can run several), the category set, freshness stamp. Answers with no key too, with a withKey block saying what a free key adds.
name: board_stats

openCompanyBoards.description: Company job boards with at least one servable posting. BOARDS, not employers — read openCompanyBoardsBasis.

refreshedAt.description: When the cache these figures come from was last written.

servablePostings.description: Postings the board serves right now: not withdrawn, dated within the freshness window. Null when the pass did not compute it.

trackedPostings.description: Every posting the board holds, including ones outside the serving rules.

withKey.description: Present on an unkeyed call: where a free key comes from and what it adds.

adds.description: What a free key opens beyond the unkeyed tools.

dailyCalls.description: Calls a day on a free key.

title: Board statistics
